title: Emergency Great Hills Land Annexation
summary:
*   **Urgent Land Annexation:** The meeting was called on an emergency basis to address legal deadlines for an annexation ordinance.
*   **316-Acre Expansion:** Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to annex 316.4 acres of land, including portions of the Great Hills area. Of this, 95 acres were city-initiated, and 221 acres were requested by a property owner.
*   **Fiscal Concerns Raised:** One council member expressed reservations about voting without an updated financial impact statement (fiscal note).
*   **Vote Delayed for Review:** The first reading passed with a 4-0 vote, but the ordinance's second reading was deferred to a later date (March 27) to allow for the requested fiscal note and further consideration.

FIRST FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM
MUNICIPAL BUILDING
Council Chambers, 301 West Second Street, Memorandum To: Mayor McClellan called to order
the Special Called Meeting of the Council scheduled for 10:30 A.M., noting the absence of
Councilmembers Cooke, Goodman and Trevino.
ANNEXATION ORDINANCE
Mayor McClellan announced the purpose of this Special Called Meeting is in the nature of
an emergency because of the legal time period involved in passage of annexations. Council
is to consider passage of an ordinance annexing 316.4 acres of land (221.10 acres
requested by owner and known as Great Hills IX, X, VIII-A and Great Hills Street
Dedication "C" and 95.04 acres initiated by the City) C7a-79-024.
Mr. Davidson, City Manager stated there is not an updated fiscal note but Council received
all necessary information at its last Meeting.
Councilmember Himmelblau said she would rather not vote until she receives a fiscal note.
Mr. Davidson said the fiscal note can be sent with the Agenda material on Friday and Mayor
McClellan told her she could change her vote next week. Councilmember Himmelblau asked for
the second reading to be on the March 27, 1980 agenda.
Motion
The Council, on Mayor Pro Tern Mullen's motion, Mayor McClellan's second, passed through
FIRST READING ONLY an ordinance annexing the following: (4-0 Vote, Councilmembers Cooke,
Goodman and Trevino absent) 316.14 acres of land (221.10 acres requested by owner and
known as Great Hills IX,X,VIH-A and Great Hills Street Dedication "C" and 95.04 acres
initiated by the city) (C7a-79-024) ADJOURNMENT
The meeting adjourned at 10:35 a.m.
